about: Sainte-Brigitte-de-Laval is a city in the La Jacques-Cartier MRC, in the hills immediately north of Québec City’s Beauport sector—not a borough of the capital. Forested valleys, a growing residential community, and access toward Jacques-Cartier park country define the municipality. About 8,000 people live in Sainte-Brigitte-de-Laval.
